svg.title: A break from the federal gas tax?
svg.desc: Two perspectives with ten picks each. Overall ranks compare the estimated impact of all twenty points. Equal scores share a rank.
svg.text: A break from the federal gas tax?
Should the U.S. pause the federal gas tax when prices spike?
Keep the gas tax in place

g.title: Pump prices — A cut helps if it reaches drivers.
g.text: A cut helps if it reaches drivers.

g.title: Road funding — A pause cuts transportation revenue.
No application — Deliver relief without paperwork.
Retail pass-through — Pump prices may fall by less than the tax.
g.text: Pump prices may fall by less than the tax.

g.title: Long commutes — Frequent drivers buy more gallons.
Relief by gallons — High fuel users get larger savings.
g.text: High fuel users get larger savings.

g.title: Small fleets — Ease fuel costs for local businesses.
g.text: Ease fuel costs for local businesses.

g.title: Transit riders — Transit riders get little direct help.
g.text: Transit riders get little direct help.

g.title: Fixed end date — Set an expiry for temporary relief.
g.text: Set an expiry for temporary relief.

g.title: Size of savings — A tax cut may barely offset a spike.
g.text: A tax cut may barely offset a spike.

g.title: Posted prices — Compare prices as the pause begins.
g.text: Compare prices as the pause begins.

g.title: Price rebound — The tax returns when the pause ends.
g.text: The tax returns when the pause ends.

g.title: Rural travel — Reach drivers with few transit options.
g.text: Reach drivers with few transit options.

g.title: Local delays — Price changes can take time to spread.
g.text: Price changes can take time to spread.

g.title: Speed of relief — A pump cut may arrive before a rebate.
g.text: A pump cut may arrive before a rebate.

g.title: Fuel efficiency — Prices can encourage fewer trips.
Price threshold — Publish a trigger for a tax pause.
g.text: Publish a trigger for a tax pause.

g.title: Targeted relief — Focus aid on commuters most in need.
g.text: Focus aid on commuters most in need.

g.title: Household budgets — Ease a recurring bill during a spike.
g.text: Ease a recurring bill during a spike.

g.title: Replacement funds — Other budgets could fill the gap.
g.text: Other budgets could fill the gap.

svg.text: AI impact weighs magnitude (50%), reach (30%) and duration (20%).
